Daily Hindu Almanac Details for September 16, 2026

The daily Hindu almanac, or Panchang, for September 16, 2026, details auspicious timings and celestial events. The day begins with the Vishakha Nakshatra and Vaidhriti Yoga. Information regarding Rahukaal, the period considered inauspicious for new beginnings, is also provided. The almanac notes the presence of three auspicious yogas, Skanda Shashti, and the Wednesday Vrat, along with Ganesh Puja. Specific timings for these events and directions to avoid are also mentioned.
